properties.description: Creates the Checkmark schema and a pass-through view over the physical checkmark_case_data table. Run manually against odw_curated_db (Built-in / serverless SQL pool) - not part of the daily pipeline. Granting access to the Checkmark managed identity is tracked separately.

content.query:
/*
THEODW: Create the Checkmark schema and a pass-through view over the
physical curated table odw_curated_db.checkmark_case_data.

odw_curated_db.checkmark_case_data is created/refreshed daily by the
'checkmark_case_data' notebook in pln_curated.

This script only needs to be run once per environment. Granting the
Checkmark managed identity access to this schema is handled separately.
*/

-- 1. Dedicated schema for Checkmark data
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT  *
                FROM    sys.schemas
                WHERE   name = 'Checkmark' )
    EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA [Checkmark]');
GO


-- 2. Thin pass-through view exposing the physical table under the Checkmark schema.
--    No Spark-only functions are used here, since all transformation logic
--    (union, dedup, JSON aggregation, costsAppliedFor derivation) already
--    happened when the physical table was written by Spark.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Checkmark.vw_checkmark_case_data
AS
SELECT
    caseReference,
    caseType,
    caseProcedure,
    caseOfficerId,
    allocationLevel,
    caseSpecialisms,
    linkedCaseStatus,
    isGreenBelt,
    costsAppliedFor,
    targetDate,
    inspectorId,
    inspectorFirstName,
    inspectorLastName,
    caseOfficerFirstName,
    caseOfficerLastName,
    event
FROM [odw_curated_db].[dbo].[checkmark_case_data];
GO
